Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is an American rapper hailing from Los Angeles, California. He first gained widespread attention in late 2018 through his viral music video for “Respect My Crypn” and his distinctive off-beat rapping style, which sparked significant online debate and discussion.

His major commercial breakthrough came in 2019 with the release of his hit single “Thotiana”. The song became a massive success on the Billboard charts, further boosted by remixes featuring high-profile artists like Cardi B and YG. Beyond his music career, he has maintained a high public profile through his active social media presence, ventures into celebrity boxing, and appearances in reality television content.
